questions.question: Q1 If transferring 10 GB over PCIe Gen4 (64 GB/s), what is the approximate transfer latency?
Q2 With Tc = 100 ms and Tt = 100 ms, what is the GPU utilization?
Q3 NVLink provides approximately how many times more bandwidth than PCIe Gen4 x16?

explanations.a: Incorrect. The ratio is much higher.

questions.question: Q4 For a compute-bound workload (Tc >> Tt), GPU utilization approaches:

explanations.b: Incorrect. 50% means equal compute and transfer.
explanations.c: Correct. When Tc >> Tt, the Tt term becomes negligible and utilization approaches 100%.

questions.question: Q5 Which scenario would benefit most from upgrading PCIe Gen4 to NVLink?

answers.a: Small data (1 GB) with long compute (500 ms)
answers.b: Large data (100 GB) with short compute (10 ms)

explanations.a: Incorrect. Small data already transfers quickly.
explanations.b: Correct. Large data with short compute creates severe I/O bottleneck that NVLink resolves.
explanations.c: Incorrect. No transfer means interconnect is irrelevant.
explanations.d: Incorrect. CPU workloads don't use GPU interconnects.

questions.question: Q6 What does 'mesh topology' mean in the context of NVLink?

answers.a: GPUs are connected in a single chain
answers.b: GPUs have multiple parallel data paths to each other

explanations.b: Correct. Mesh topology provides multiple simultaneous communication paths.
explanations.d: Incorrect. GPUs must be connected for communication.

questions.question: Q7 If GPU utilization is 30%, what does this indicate?

answers.c: The GPU has too much memory
answers.d: The compute time is too long

explanations.b: Correct. 70% of the step time is spent waiting for data, indicating a severe I/O bottleneck.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Memory amount is unrelated to utilization.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Longer compute would actually increase utilization.

questions.question: Q8 Doubling the interconnect bandwidth while keeping data size constant will:

explanations.b: Correct. Tt = D/Bandwidth, so doubling bandwidth halves the transfer time.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Bandwidth directly affects transfer latency.
explanations.d: Incorrect. GPU processing time is independent of bandwidth.

questions.question: Q9 What is 'direct memory fabric mapping' in NVLink?

answers.a: GPUs share the same physical memory chip
answers.b: GPUs can access each other's VRAM directly without CPU intervention
answers.c: Memory is stored on the network switch
answers.d: Each GPU can only access its own memory

explanations.a: Incorrect. Each GPU has its own VRAM.
explanations.b: Correct. NVLink enables unified memory addressing across GPUs.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Memory is not stored on switches.
explanations.d: Incorrect. NVLink enables cross-GPU memory access.

questions.question: Q10 What is the key takeaway from this experiment?

answers.b: Interconnect bandwidth critically determines GPU efficiency for large data workloads
answers.c: GPU computation speed is the only factor that matters

explanations.a: Incorrect. Performance varies dramatically between standards.
explanations.b: Correct. The experiment shows how I/O bottlenecks waste GPU resources and how higher bandwidth resolves them.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Data transfer speed is equally important.
explanations.d: Incorrect. PCIe Gen4 becomes a bottleneck for large transfers.
